newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends little changed on poor leads.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends little changed on poor leads.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices finished little changed after lack of big participation and poor leads limited activity. News of Jan 1-25 export was discounted by the market which awaited fresh demand. Trading was cautious. Gains were marginal.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL -Scattered interest was seen with players awaiting a clearer path. Business was seen among CPOs.
Prices were locked in a boxed-range for the greater part of the day as players refused to take up fresh positions while waiting fresh tenders, they said.

"No one was interested in trading actively as there was no demand," another trader said. "The market is waiting for fresh tenders from India and Pakistan.It's has been a while that the buyers are not in."
Traders said a public holiday in several states of Malaysia also affected activity.
Third month, April futures closed five ringgit up at 1,265 ringgit ($508.24) a tonne.
Physical Jan (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,335 against bids at 1,325 after trading at 1,330 to 1,325.
Jan (central) was offered at 1,330 and bids at 1,325 with early trades at 1,325 and Jan (north) at 1,310 against 1,300.
Feb (south) saw offers at 1,330 with bids at 1,325 with earlier trades of 1,330, and Feb (central) at 1,325 against 1,320.
Among refined products, Feb RBD palm oil was offered at $560 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Mar at $552.50.
Feb RBD palm olein saw offers at $590, Mar at $582.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $572.50.
Feb/Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $445 and Feb/Mar palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $302.50.
